Run 8 unseen RAW videos from Editdna bloopers videos/ through PURE CLEAN CUT generalization validation. Use CUTSELL_EDITORIAL_MODE=clean_cut with dense local performance, whole-video context, retry grouping, Best Take, dead-air/boundary cleanup, and natural source order. Do not apply sales semantics/composer/reviewer. This is an unseen generalization gate: do not tune thresholds before reviewing results. Validate preservation, retry resolution, bad-take removal, boundary quality, and absence of broad overcut.
